pages.text: The $(d)Emerald Heart$() Gene causes mobs to $(9)drop an Emerald upon death$().$(br2)Players with it may make special sounds when chatting.$(br2)This Gene $(9)can be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)3/7 - Evoker$(br)2/7 - Pillager$(br)2/9 - Villager$(br)2/10 - Vindicator$(br)4/9 - Zombie Villager
